$comment: License/provenance of every file in the AI manifest (src-tauri/src/ai/manifest.rs, the single source of URLs, sizes and SHA-256). This file adds what the manifest does not carry: weight license vs. code license, architecture, training data, attribution duties. tests/unit/legal-inventory.test.mjs fails if a manifest file is missing here (or vice versa). Nothing here is bundled: files are downloaded on first use after user confirmation. See legal/INVENTORY.md.

components.name: ONNX Runtime Web
components.author: Microsoft Corporation
components.notes: The WASM build statically contains ONNX Runtime's own dependencies; their notices are in ThirdPartyNotices.txt, which is downloaded and stored next to the runtime.

components.name: 4xRealWebPhoto v4 (DAT-2)

architecture.name: DAT (Dual Aggregation Transformer), Zheng Chen et al.

components.trainingData: Not recorded in VHO. Must be read from the model card / author's release notes and recorded here before a public release (open item).
components.attribution: CC BY 4.0: credit the creator, link the license, state changes. Done in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES section 1.2 and Settings > AI models.
components.modifications: File kept byte-identical on disk. At load, in memory only, two symbolic output dimension names are renamed (WebGPU workaround); weights and computation unchanged.

face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx.name: YuNet (2023mar)
face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx.trainingData: Reported upstream as trained on WIDER FACE, whose own terms restrict the dataset to non-commercial research. Whether dataset terms reach the MIT-licensed weights is legally unsettled: user decision (legal/INVENTORY.md, open items). To be re-verified from the official repository before release.

GFPGANv1.4-w16.onnx.role: face restoration weights (ONNX export, float16-stored weights)
GFPGANv1.4-w16.onnx.name: GFPGAN v1.4
GFPGANv1.4-w16.onnx.trainingData: GFPGAN is trained on FFHQ (NVIDIA; dataset distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, images under their own licenses). Same open question as YuNet: user decision before release. To be re-verified from the official repository.
GFPGANv1.4-w16.onnx.excludedParts: GFPGAN's LICENSE also lists StyleGAN2 CUDA ops (NVIDIA Source Code License) and DFDNet (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). VHO uses neither (v1.4 'clean' architecture, no DFDNet).

components.name: GFPGAN v1.4 + YuNet
components.notes: Weight licenses are permissive. Status review because of the training-data question; accepted by the owner on 2026-10-25 (see acknowledged).
components.acknowledged: 2026-10-25 owner decision: GFPGAN and YuNet stay in the app (quality first). The non-commercial training-data question (WIDER FACE / FFHQ) is an accepted, owner-decided risk; to be reviewed with a lawyer. Re-verify the training data from the official repositories before each release.
